propositions: SupportsIncremental is a @runtime_checkable Protocol with zero implementers and zero dispatch sites (no isinstance checks in src/)
The SupportsIncremental docstring asserts that core uses incremental fetch conditionally, but this behaviour is never invoked and not implemented

Removing SupportsIncremental requires deleting two test cases (test_backends_without_incremental_are_detected and test_dc_backend_is_deliberately_not_incremental) and amending ADR 0035 to reflect the reduction from three to two opt-in capability Protocols
The capability removal is correctness-neutral because full-scan fetch already runs unconditionally and is the only fetch path in use
Coverage of the isinstance skip-branch (a backend declining a capability is not driven through it) is retained by existing SupportsLinks negative tests after SupportsIncremental deletion
